entities.name: Kiyohara no Fukayabu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kiyohara no Fukayabu was a Japanese poet of Heian period. He is an author of the thirty-sixth poem of the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu and contributor of 17 poems to the Kokin Wakashū.
